Sign in to see the code and copy it.

Tweak it first: drag a lime number sideways, or focus it and press ↑ or ↓ (Shift for bigger steps). The preview follows, and Copy takes your version.

In Fusion, right-click in the Inspector, choose Expression, paste and press Enter.

In Fusion, click an empty spot in the Node Editor and press Ctrl+V (Cmd+V on a Mac), then connect MediaIn1 to and to MediaOut1.

In Fusion, click an empty spot in the Node Editor and press Ctrl+V (Cmd+V on a Mac), then connect to MediaOut1.

Attach it to an AI chat such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Copilot, or paste it in, then describe what you want.

In Fusion, open Workspace › Console, choose Lua, paste and press Enter.
